title: refactor: move model monitor to operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Moves the official Model Monitor website from `apps/model-monitor` to `operations/model-monitor`.
- Deletes its stale duplicate daemon files; the active Discord/leaderboard bot remains in `operations/community-monitor`.
- Adds an operations-owned deployment manifest and detector.
- Redeploys Model Monitor and Economics when their shared UI/SDK dependencies change.
- Removes Model Monitor from community-app deployment ownership.

## Cloudflare and bot safety

- Reuses the existing `apps-model-monitor` Direct Upload Pages project.
- Keeps both Model Monitor domains unchanged.
- Uses the existing Pages-authorized GitHub Actions token; no secret is changed.
- Allows production deployment only from the `production` branch.
- A failed upload leaves the previous Pages deployment serving.
- The live Community Monitor box already follows `operations/community-monitor`; today's text and image leaderboards posted successfully and tomorrow's generator files are present.

After merge, the production sync triggers the new operations workflow. No direct Cloudflare deployment is performed by this PR.

## Validation

- Model Monitor build and local browser verification passed with live data and no console errors.
- Operations detector and all GitHub script tests passed.
- App catalog, workflow YAML, diff checks, and GitHub CI passed.

gist.blurb: Model Monitor has moved into the operations garden, where its deployment wiring and shared dependencies can be tended in one place. The old duplicate daemon files have been composted; the Community Monitor bot keeps buzzing along from its existing home.
